name: Entity body class
description: Adds a 'Body CSS class(es)' base field to entities; its value (token-aware) is output as a class on the page <body>.
project_description:
Provides a new "Body CSS class(es)" field for all entity types. The value of the field will be added as a class for the body tag on the entity page.

 Entity types: 
 The module supports all entity types that have canonical routes. e.g. Node, Taxonomy term, User, Comment, Media, etc.

 Permissions: 
 You can configure who can see the field on the form by managing the Manage body class fields permission.

You can configure who can add default values on the /admin/config/content/body-class-settings page by managing the Manage body class settings permission.

 Form display: 
 The module adds a base field that can be hidden by moving it to the disabled region on the manage form display page.

There is a validation callback for the field to filter values against XSS. The field also supports tokens.

 Maintainers: 
 This project is originally written by AstonVictor .
